request.style: English, female solo voice, ethereal and reverent, piano, strings, cello, soft drums, majestic and contemplative, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Some days later in Caesarea town
The King and his sister arrived now
To pay their respects to the new governor
With great pomp they entered the hall of power

[Pre-Chorus]
Paul was brought in at the order of Festus
To speak his defense before the men
The King gave him permission to speak
And Paul stretched out his hand in the end

[Chorus]
This man has done nothing deserving death
Or imprisonment for the charges laid
He spoke of light and of the risen Lord
And they agreed that no guilt was weighed

[Verse]
I saw a light brighter than the sun
Blazing around me on the road to Damascus
The Lord said I am Jesus whom you persecute
Arise and stand on your feet, it was said

[Pre-Chorus]
I was not disobedient to the vision
I preached to Damascus and Jerusalem
To Israel and the Gentiles alike
That they should repent and turn to Him

[Chorus]
This man has done nothing deserving death
Or imprisonment for the charges laid
He spoke of light and of the risen Lord
And they agreed that no guilt was weighed

[Bridge]
The King rose up with the governor
And Bernice and those who were seated
As they withdrew they spoke to one another
With words of truth that they believed

[Outro]
He could have been set free if he had not appealed
To Caesar's court in the end
